name_th: ความสุข
core_read: Open, easy warmth: the viewer feels things are good right now and wants to stay in the moment.

approaches.name: Sunlit shared moment
approaches.palette_direction: Warm saturated daylight: butter yellow #F6D26B, coral #F28C6B, leaf green #7DBE6A, sky #9FD3F0
approaches.character_expression: Genuine Duchenne smile, eyes creased, mid-laugh
approaches.body_language: Open shoulders, leaning toward each other, hands in motion
approaches.environment: Outdoor cafe or park, soft background people
approaches.negative_space: Moderate; sky or bokeh above heads gives lift
approaches.visual_metaphor: Light pouring in = good things arriving

approaches.name: Graphic flat celebration
approaches.palette_direction: High-key pastel pop: mint #A8E6CF, peach #FFD3B6, pink #FFAAA5, cream #FFF8E7
approaches.character_expression: Simplified big smile, closed happy eyes
approaches.body_language: Arms up or bouncing pose, motion lines
approaches.environment: Plain colour field with confetti-like shapes
approaches.negative_space: Large flat background as breathing room
approaches.visual_metaphor: Shapes radiating outward like a burst

approaches.name: Quiet detail of happiness
approaches.palette_direction: Soft natural neutrals with one warm note: linen #EDE6DA, oat #D8C8B0, honey #E0A84F
approaches.character_expression: Partial face or none; corner of a smile
approaches.body_language: Hands holding a warm cup or a child's hand
approaches.visual_metaphor: A small ordinary thing as the whole world

contrast_levers: Raise: saturation, warmth, more people, open gestures, motion blur on laughter. Lower: muted palette, single person, still pose, more empty space (shifts toward contentment).
cultural_notes: A smile carries many meanings in Thai social life, so posture and context must confirm joy. Yellow has royal associations in Thailand; avoid it as political signalling. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Stock-photo group jumping on a beach
ai_mistakes: Models give every face the same toothy smile
Teeth and hands deform in group shots
eyewear_angle: Very suitable: friends trying frames together in sunlight, a parent seeing a child read clearly; keep lens reflections controlled so eyes stay visible.

name_th: ปีติยินดี / ดีใจสุดขีด
core_read: A peak burst of joy that overflows the body; energy upward and outward.

approaches.name: Leap against the sky
approaches.palette_direction: Vivid sky blue #3FA9F5 with hot accent #FF5A5F and sun white #FFF6D5
approaches.character_expression: Head thrown back, mouth open in a shout
approaches.environment: Open field, rooftop or beach with big sky

approaches.name: Explosion of colour and motion
approaches.palette_direction: Fauvist clash: magenta #E5267A, cobalt #1F4FD1, citrus #FFC300, lime #9BE15D

approaches.name: Private triumph close-up
approaches.palette_direction: Warm golds in darkness: amber #F2A541, deep brown #3A2414, warm skin #E7B48C
approaches.character_expression: Tears of joy with an open laugh, bright eyes
approaches.body_language: Hands pressed to mouth or fists near chest
approaches.environment: Dark room, a phone screen glow or a letter

contrast_levers: Raise: diagonal and airborne poses, saturated complementary colours, low angle, motion blur. Lower: grounded pose, eye level, one accent colour only.
cultural_notes: Fireworks and red/gold read as festival (Loy Krathong, Chinese New Year) in Thai and Thai-Chinese contexts; that can help or clutter. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Airborne bodies get broken limbs or extra legs
Confetti fills the frame and erases the subject
eyewear_angle: Possible: a customer's first clear look at a distant view after new lenses, shot low against the sky; never frames flying off the face.

name_th: ความพอใจ / อิ่มใจ
core_read: Settled, unhurried satisfaction; nothing needs to change.

approaches.name: Cozy interior stillness
approaches.palette_direction: Warm low-chroma: oatmeal #E3D5C0, terracotta #C47A57, olive #7A7F4E, cream #F6EFE3
approaches.body_language: Curled in a chair, shoulders down, tea in hands
approaches.negative_space: Wall space and window give quiet

approaches.name: Wide calm landscape
approaches.palette_direction: Soft late-afternoon pastels: pale gold #F3E2B3, sage #A9B89A, dusk lilac #C7B8D6
approaches.body_language: Sitting still, leaning back on hands
approaches.visual_metaphor: Rest at the end of a road

approaches.name: Top-down simple pleasures
approaches.palette_direction: Cool fresh neutrals with one warm note: snow #FAFAFA, pale grey #DADADA, butter #F2D27A
approaches.environment: Breakfast table, open notebook, folded glasses

contrast_levers: Raise: warmer light, more personal objects, closer framing. Lower: cooler tones, wider shot, smaller figure (too empty drifts to loneliness).
cultural_notes: Thai 'sabai' ease and 'pho jai' (satisfied with enough) suit simple, uncluttered scenes; do not use Buddhist imagery as decoration. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Hygge clichés: candles and fairy lights everywhere
ai_mistakes: Models over-decorate cozy rooms into clutter
Faces get a big grin instead of a soft one
eyewear_angle: Very suitable: folded frames on a breakfast table, a reader with glasses in a reading nook; the product as a calm everyday companion.

name_th: ขบขัน / ขำ
core_read: Something is funny; the viewer is invited into the joke.

approaches.name: Reaction shot two-hander
approaches.palette_direction: Bright playful mid-tones: tangerine #F7954A, teal #3BB3A8, cream #FFF4E0
approaches.character_expression: Suppressed laugh, nose scrunch, hand over mouth
approaches.environment: Cafe table, a friend telling a story
approaches.negative_space: Little; the other person's shoulder frames

approaches.name: Cartoon visual gag
approaches.palette_direction: Primary cartoon: red #E63946, yellow #FFD60A, blue #457B9D, off-white #F1FAEE
approaches.character_expression: Exaggerated squash-and-stretch grin, tears of laughter
approaches.environment: Simple stage with one absurd object
approaches.negative_space: Flat background so the gag reads
approaches.visual_metaphor: Absurd mismatch (a cat in huge glasses)

approaches.name: Deadpan comedy tableau
approaches.palette_direction: Muted pastel symmetry: dusty pink #E8B4B8, mint #B8E0D2, mustard #D9B44A
approaches.character_expression: Completely straight face while chaos happens
approaches.environment: Symmetrical room with one thing absurdly wrong
approaches.negative_space: Balanced empty walls amplify the oddity

contrast_levers: Raise: exaggeration, implied speed, brighter primaries. Lower: deadpan stillness, symmetry, muted pastels (dry wit).
cultural_notes: Thai humour often favours slapstick and wordplay; visual gags travel better than English puns. Never mock monks, royalty or disability. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Hands over mouth merge with the face
Cartoon gags lack a readable cause
eyewear_angle: Suitable: a pet or kid in oversized frames, a 'can't read the menu' gag solved by glasses; kind, never mocking poor eyesight.

name_th: ภาคภูมิใจ
core_read: Earned self-worth: chest up, achievement acknowledged.

approaches.name: Heroic low angle
approaches.palette_direction: Deep rich tones: navy #1D2A4A, gold #C9A227, ivory #F4EEDC
approaches.character_expression: Small closed smile, chin slightly raised
approaches.body_language: Chest open, shoulders back, holding the result

approaches.name: Maker with the work
approaches.palette_direction: Warm workshop: walnut #6B4A2F, brass #B08D57, linen #E8DFCF, phthalo green #123A29
approaches.character_expression: Quiet satisfied look at the object, not the camera
approaches.body_language: Hands resting on the finished piece

approaches.name: Graphic emblem of achievement
approaches.palette_direction: Bold two-colour: crimson #B3202A on cream #F3E9D2, or phthalo #123A29 on peach #EFCF9C
approaches.negative_space: Rays fill but leave a halo

contrast_levers: Raise: lower camera, more rim light, symmetry, vertical lines. Lower: eye level, side view, soft light (quiet pride). Pushed too far it reads as arrogance or gloating.
cultural_notes: In Thai culture overt self-display can read as boastful; humble pride shared with family or teachers lands better (graduation photos with family and garlands are a strong Thai pride image). Sunburst rays resemble some flags — check context. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Arms raised on a mountain top
ai_mistakes: Models make pride arrogant with sneering faces
Trophies and certificates get garbled fake text
eyewear_angle: Suitable: an optician proud of a well-fitted pair, a graduate in new frames with family; keep it humble.

name_th: ความเศร้า
core_read: A heavy, inward pull; energy drained, the viewer wants to comfort.

approaches.name: Small figure in cold space
approaches.palette_direction: Cold desaturated: slate #5B6770, fog grey #A7B0B6, ink blue #2E3A4A
approaches.body_language: Head down, shoulders rounded, arms close
approaches.environment: Empty platform, winter beach, wide street
approaches.negative_space: Dominant, pressing down on the figure

approaches.name: Warm but empty room
approaches.palette_direction: Warm faded: lamp amber #D9A066, dusty rose #B98B82, brown #4A3B32
approaches.character_expression: No person; the absence is the subject
approaches.body_language: Implied by objects: one cup, one side of the bed unmade
approaches.environment: Lived-in room, a coat still on its hook

approaches.name: Hand in rain light
approaches.palette_direction: Blue-grey with soft skin warmth: rain grey #7F8C99, cool blue #4E6E8E, skin #D7B9A5
approaches.character_expression: Not shown, or lowered eyelids only
approaches.body_language: Hand resting on window glass or loosely holding a phone
approaches.visual_metaphor: Rain as the tears outside the person

contrast_levers: Raise: wider shot, smaller figure, cooler tones, lower contrast, downward lines. Lower: closer framing, warm light, a second presence entering frame (shifts to comfort).
cultural_notes: White and black are funeral colours in Thailand; using them strongly signals death, not just sadness. Do not use monks or temples as sad props. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models default to a single tear and blue tint for sadness
eyewear_angle: Use carefully as the 'before' of a story (struggling to read a letter from a loved one) that resolves; not for direct sales imagery.

name_th: โศกเศร้าจากการสูญเสีย
core_read: Loss of someone or something irreplaceable; deep, slow, sometimes numb.

approaches.name: Ritual stillness
approaches.palette_direction: Thai mourning tones: black #111111, white #F5F5F0, soft grey #8C8C88, one marigold #E8A33D
approaches.environment: Quiet hall or home, white flowers

approaches.name: Object left behind
approaches.palette_direction: Faded warm sepia: sepia #A58B6F, paper #E9DFCC, shadow #3B3229
approaches.body_language: None; the object stands for the person
approaches.environment: Old glasses on a book, a cardigan on a chair

approaches.name: Collapsed embrace
approaches.palette_direction: Deep shadow with cool highlight: charcoal #2A2A2A, cool grey #9AA3A8, bone #E6E1D8
approaches.body_language: Two bodies leaning in, weight given away
approaches.visual_metaphor: Holding up the one who cannot stand

contrast_levers: Raise: stillness, symmetry, dark/white extremes, absence. Lower: gentle warm light, memory inserts, a hand reaching in.
cultural_notes: Thai funerals use black/white clothing, white flowers and chanting; bright red is avoided. Thai-Chinese mourning uses white. Never stage monks, coffins or ashes for content. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models add Western coffins and crosses by default
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads. At most a gentle memorial story (a grandfather's glasses) with consent and no product push.

name_th: เศร้าสร้อย / หม่นหมอง
core_read: Soft, reflective, almost beautiful sadness; a lingering mood rather than a crisis.

approaches.name: Twilight window gaze
approaches.palette_direction: Blue-hour lilac and teal: dusk violet #6C5B7B, teal #355C7D, lamp amber #F8B195
approaches.body_language: Chin on hand, leaning on the window frame

approaches.name: Rainy-season wander
approaches.palette_direction: Muted wet tones: rust #A0522D, olive #6B6B3A, mist #C9C5BA
approaches.environment: Quiet soi or tree-lined path after rain

approaches.name: Monochrome memory
approaches.palette_direction: Near-monochrome pencil: graphite #4A4A4A, paper #F1EEE7, one faded blue #8FA3B8

contrast_levers: Raise: cooler hue, longer shadows, more fog, slower lines. Lower: add a warm practical light and close in (toward nostalgia).
cultural_notes: The Thai rainy season (ฤดูฝน) and songs of longing pair well with melancholy; keep it local (soi, motorbike, rain) rather than imported autumn-in-Paris imagery. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Girl with coffee staring out of a rainy window
ai_mistakes: Models make melancholy identical to sadness (tears)
Autumn leaves in tropical Thai scenes
eyewear_angle: Suitable in moderation: reflective storytelling carousels (Slowly Growing style), a reader at a dusk window with reading glasses.

name_th: สิ้นหวัง
core_read: Hope gone; crushing weight, no way out.

approaches.name: Crushed under darkness
approaches.palette_direction: Near-black with ash: black #0D0D0D, ash #3E3E3E, cold grey #6E7378
approaches.body_language: Curled on the floor, knees to chest

approaches.name: Expressionist distortion
approaches.palette_direction: Acid clash on dark: bruise purple #4B2C5E, acid green #8DB33A, dried red #5A1A1A

approaches.name: Endless corridor
approaches.palette_direction: Sickly fluorescent: pale green #B8C4A8, grey #8A8F88, shadow #2C2F2B

contrast_levers: Raise: lower key, tighter enclosure, overhead angle, distortion. Lower: a sliver of light, eye level, another person (toward hope).
cultural_notes: Do not depict self-harm or suicide; it is unsafe, platform-restricted and taboo in Thai brand content. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Person in rain with hands raised
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: โกรธจัด / โมโห
core_read: Explosive, visible anger: heat, pressure, readiness to strike.

approaches.name: Red heat close-up
approaches.palette_direction: Hot reds and oranges: crimson #C1121F, ember #F77F00, black #1B1B1B
approaches.character_expression: Brows down, jaw clenched, nostrils flared

approaches.name: Confrontation diagonal
approaches.palette_direction: Complementary clash: red-orange #E4572E vs. cold blue #29335C
approaches.negative_space: The gap between figures is charged

approaches.name: Symbolic storm
approaches.palette_direction: Storm darks with lightning: charcoal #262626, violet #5A189A, flash white #F8F9FA

contrast_levers: Raise: red saturation, under light, low angle, tight crop, diagonals. Lower: cooler palette, wider shot, symmetry (toward cold anger).
cultural_notes: Thai social norms value 'jai yen' (a cool heart); public hot anger reads as loss of face, so in Thai content it is usually comic or villainous. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models paint the whole image red
eyewear_angle: Only as a comic 'before' beat (frustration at blurry vision); never aggressive imagery next to the product.

name_th: โกรธเย็นชา
core_read: Controlled, icy fury; stillness that threatens more than shouting.

approaches.name: Icy stare
approaches.palette_direction: Cold steel: steel blue #3A506B, ice #DCE3E8, black #0B0C10

approaches.name: Power distance
approaches.palette_direction: Muted corporate: charcoal #333333, cold grey #9BA4AB, one deep red #7A1C1C
approaches.body_language: Standing behind a desk, hands flat
approaches.environment: Large office or hall, long table

approaches.name: Graphic noir silhouette
approaches.palette_direction: Black and white with one cold accent: black #000000, white #FFFFFF, cyan #2EC4B6

contrast_levers: Raise: stillness, symmetry, colder palette, harder side light. Lower: warmer tones, softer light (toward disappointment).
cultural_notes: Because of 'jai yen', cold anger is more socially plausible in Thai settings than shouting; a polite smile with cold eyes is a recognisable local cue. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models give cold anger a shouting mouth
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads; possible as an antagonist beat in story clips.

name_th: รำคาญ
core_read: Small nagging annoyance; an itch, not an explosion.

approaches.name: Everyday annoyance
approaches.palette_direction: Slightly off everyday: dull yellow #D4B44A, grey-blue #8E9AAF, white #F4F4F4
approaches.character_expression: One eyebrow raised, side-eye, pursed lips

approaches.name: Cartoon scribble
approaches.palette_direction: Clean pastel with one jarring accent: lavender #D7C9F2, mint #C5F0E0, jarring orange #FF7F11
approaches.body_language: Hunched, glaring at a small object

approaches.name: Repeating nuisance
approaches.palette_direction: Neutral grid with a discordant red: off-white #EFEFEF, grey #BDBDBD, red #D62828
approaches.environment: Objects in a grid with one misaligned
approaches.visual_metaphor: The one that will not line up

contrast_levers: Raise: more repetitions of the nuisance, harsher light, tighter crop. Lower: humour, pastel tones.
cultural_notes: Thai irritation is usually masked; a tight 'เบื่อ' smile is relatable and comic. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
cliches_to_avoid: Full rage for a minor thing
ai_mistakes: Cartoon symbols rendered as garbled text
eyewear_angle: Suitable with humour: smudged lenses, glasses sliding down the nose, solved by a fit adjustment.

name_th: หงุดหงิด / คับข้องใจ
core_read: Blocked effort: trying and failing, energy with nowhere to go.

approaches.name: Tangled struggle
approaches.palette_direction: Dusty warm with dark: mustard #C9A227, rust #9C4A2F, charcoal #2E2E2E
approaches.body_language: Hunched over desk, hands in hair
approaches.visual_metaphor: A knot that will not untie

approaches.name: Figure against the wall
approaches.palette_direction: Flat cold grey wall with a warm figure: grey #8D99AE, near-white #EDF2F4, red #EF233C
approaches.environment: A huge wall filling the frame

approaches.name: Squinting at the blur
approaches.palette_direction: Neutral cool with sharp highlight: grey #6C757D, white #F8F9FA, screen blue #4CC9F0
approaches.body_language: Leaning in too close to the screen

contrast_levers: Raise: clutter, repeated failure, tighter frame, harsh light. Lower: one calm element, humour.
cultural_notes: Everyday frustrations (traffic, slow apps, small print) travel well in Thai content; never blame specific groups. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models show anger instead of blocked effort
eyewear_angle: Very suitable as the problem beat: squinting at small print or a blurry screen, resolved by the right lenses. Keep it light.

name_th: เดือดดาล / คลั่ง
core_read: Uncontrolled destructive fury; reason gone.

approaches.name: Expressionist inferno
approaches.palette_direction: Saturated fire: blood red #8B0000, flame orange #FF4500, black #000000

approaches.name: Manga impact
approaches.palette_direction: Black and white with a red spot: black #000000, white #FFFFFF, red #D00000

approaches.name: Aftermath
approaches.palette_direction: Cold post-storm: ash grey #6B6B6B, dust beige #BFB5A3, one red #9D0208

contrast_levers: Raise: red, motion, distortion, tilt, close-up. Lower: show the aftermath instead of the act.
cultural_notes: Rage imagery can read as violent content and be restricted; in Thai content it is usually villain or comedy. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: กลัว
core_read: A threat is present; the body wants to retreat and the viewer feels exposed.

approaches.name: Threat from the dark
approaches.palette_direction: Low-key cool: midnight #0B1D2A, cold blue #2F4858, pale skin #D9D2C5
approaches.character_expression: Wide eyes, raised brows, mouth slightly open
approaches.negative_space: Large dark area where the threat could be

approaches.name: Looming scale
approaches.palette_direction: Murky green-grey: swamp #3A4A3F, grey #707A72, sick yellow #C2B97F

approaches.name: Hiding close-up
approaches.palette_direction: Desaturated dark with torch warmth: dark #1A1A1A, torch yellow #F2D16B
approaches.environment: Under a bed or behind a door gap

contrast_levers: Raise: more darkness, threat only partly visible, high angle on the victim, under light. Lower: show the source clearly (reduces dread), warmer light.
cultural_notes: Thai ghost culture (ผี: Phi Pop, Krasue, Nang Tani) is strong and specific; use folklore respectfully and never with sacred objects. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models default to Western horror tropes
eyewear_angle: Only as a light problem beat (fear of night driving with glare), resolved by anti-glare lenses; no horror imagery.

name_th: ตื่นตระหนก
core_read: Overwhelming fear with loss of control; chaos and speed.

approaches.name: Chaotic crowd blur
approaches.palette_direction: Harsh mixed light: alarm red #E63946, flash white #F1FAEE, dark navy #1D3557

approaches.name: Tunnel vision
approaches.palette_direction: Pulsing red edge to black: blood red #9B111E, black #000000

approaches.name: Fragmented panels
approaches.palette_direction: Clashing complementaries: cyan #00B4D8, red #EF233C, yellow #FFD60A
approaches.camera_angle: mixed high and low angles across panels

contrast_levers: Raise: tilt, blur, fragmentation, red. Lower: one stable element in frame, slower motion (toward anxiety).
cultural_notes: Panic scenes resembling real disasters (floods, fires, crowd crushes in Thailand) can distress viewers; avoid them. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: วิตกกังวล
core_read: Diffuse ongoing unease; the threat is in the head, not in the room.

approaches.name: Cluttered closing space
approaches.palette_direction: Off greens and greys: muted olive #6B705C, sick beige #DDD5C7, screen blue #5E8BA8

approaches.name: Scribbled thoughts
approaches.palette_direction: Graphite with nervous red: graphite #555555, paper #F3F0E8, red pencil #C0392B

approaches.name: Tiny figure, tilted world
approaches.palette_direction: Cold pale: pale cyan #CDE7EA, grey #9AA5AD, near-black #22272B
approaches.body_language: Standing at the edge of something

contrast_levers: Raise: clutter, tilt, cold greens, repeated objects (clocks, screens). Lower: one calm anchor, warm light, level horizon.
cultural_notes: Mental health is discussed less openly in Thai culture; gentle, non-clinical depictions are better received. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
eyewear_angle: Possible: worry about screen eye strain, answered with blue-light advice; gentle, no medical claims.

name_th: เป็นห่วง / กังวลใจ
core_read: Concern about someone or something specific; caring tension.

approaches.name: Waiting at the window
approaches.palette_direction: Dim warm/cool mix: lamp amber #E0A458, night blue #2C3E50, curtain beige #D8CAB8
approaches.visual_metaphor: Waiting for someone to come home

approaches.name: Hands clasped
approaches.palette_direction: Soft neutral: skin #C9A68A, cream #EFE7DA, shadow brown #5A4636

approaches.name: Watching from a distance
approaches.palette_direction: Muted pastel: dusty blue #A3B8C8, pale yellow #F3E6B5, grey #9E9E9E
approaches.environment: Child ahead on a bicycle or at a school gate

contrast_levers: Raise: more distance between the worrier and what they worry about, night, tighter hands. Lower: daylight, closeness (toward relief).
cultural_notes: Thai family care ('เป็นห่วง') is often shown through food and check-ins; parents worried about kids' screen time is very relatable. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
eyewear_angle: Suitable: a parent noticing a child squint at the board, leading to an eye exam; caring, never fear-mongering.

name_th: หวาดหวั่น / ลางร้าย
core_read: Slow, heavy anticipation of something bad that has not arrived yet.

approaches.name: Calm before it arrives
approaches.palette_direction: Bruised sky: storm slate #4A5560, sulphur yellow #C9B458, dark field #2B2F26
approaches.environment: Flat field or empty road under a building storm

approaches.name: The door at the end
approaches.palette_direction: Dim warm-to-black: dirty amber #8C6A3F, brown-black #1E1915, one cold line #9FB3C8
approaches.character_expression: Face turned away toward the door
approaches.environment: Long corridor, a door ajar with light under it
approaches.symbolism: Door ajar, light under a door

approaches.name: Overhead stillness
approaches.palette_direction: Cold sickly greens: grey-green #6E7D6B, pale green #C7D1BE, black #141614
approaches.body_language: Rigid on the bed, not moving
approaches.environment: Bedroom at night, a phone face down

contrast_levers: Raise: more empty space, slower stillness, darker sky, threat only implied. Lower: reveal the threat (turns into fear), add warm light.
cultural_notes: Thai horror relies heavily on dread and folklore; avoid using real shrines, spirit houses or Buddha images as ominous props. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Models reveal a monster instead of implying
Fake ghost faces in the background
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: ขยะแขยง
core_read: Rejection of something offensive or contaminated; the body pulls back.

name_th: อาย / เขิน (ขายหน้า)

contrast_levers: Raise: more onlookers, spotlight, red flush. Lower: private moment, humour.

eyewear_angle: Suitable with gentle humour: waving at the wrong person because of blurry vision, leading to an eye check.

contrast_levers: Raise: high angle, small figure, hard exposing light. Lower: soft light, someone reaching out (toward comfort).
cultural_notes: Shame and face are culturally loaded in Thailand; never depict real people or groups as shameful. Body-shaming imagery is off-limits. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: สำนึกผิด / ขอโทษ

approaches.body_language: Bowing slightly, offering something with both hands

approaches.name: Mending
approaches.palette_direction: Kintsugi-like warm: ceramic cream #EFE8DC, gold seam #C9A227, dark #2A2A2A

contrast_levers: Raise: lower head, rain, distance. Lower: closer framing, offered hands (toward reconciliation).
cultural_notes: Thai apologies use the wai and soft speech; apologising with both hands offering a gift is respectful. Kintsugi is Japanese — fine as a metaphor but do not label it Thai. Colour meanings are context-dependent and their measured effects are modest and situational (ElliotMaier2014); treat palettes as Artistic starting points.
ai_mistakes: Kintsugi gold rendered as random lines
eyewear_angle: Suitable for service-recovery posts (sorry for a delay) with a sincere tone; mending imagery for repairs and frame adjustment.
